prompt:
Image 1 is the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall of a room. Edit it into the same view of the same room at this time of day: Day. Keep the camera position, framing, lens, walls, doors, windows, furniture, materials and colours exactly as in Image 1; change only the light. Outside every window and doorway, show what that place looks like at Day, with the sky, light and lit windows of that time, never the daylight scene of Image 1 darkened. Inside, light the room as the description says it is lit at that time, with only the lamps it names turned on. The place stays completely empty of people: no person, figure, silhouette or reflection of a person anywhere. Location: INT. JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM. A grand, contemporary villa living room in cream, gold and white marble. Back wall: tall French windows onto a garden of leafy trees, flooding the room with warm afternoon sunlight from the back and slightly from the left, with leaves swaying outside. Centred before these windows is a long cream leather sofa with its back to them, facing the camera. In front of it is a low marble-and-gilt coffee table on a large beige patterned carpet. Left wall: a fat white marble column stands in front of it near the back corner, with an open archway to the entrance hall behind it, the way in and out. Right wall: a marble fireplace with a large abstract painting above it, flanked by a cream armchair. Front wall, behind the camera: built-in display cabinets. Light comes from the sunlight through the back windows and a crystal chandelier overhead.

Avoid: people or silhouettes, a darkened copy of Image 1's daylight, readable text, labels, signs with letters or numbers, logos, watermark.
